subject: Integration test plan + BLOCKING C/Rust NativeDispatchV2 ABI mismatch (repro)
body:
Role integration_tests initial plan. I own only new gpu/tests/metal_resource_integration_test.py plus new worker files; production read-only, no phone/build/commit.

BLOCKING ABI finding (verified now, stable source, executable repro):
C gpu/metal/tegu/air_bridge.h TeguAIRComputeRegion has groups[3],constant_count,constants[64],push[128] = 1168 bytes and NO flags field. Rust air_bridge.rs ComputeRegion has groups[3],flags,constant_count,constants[64],push[128] = 1172 and const assert NativeDispatchV2==11240. Measured C: sizeof(region)=1168, sizeof(NativeDispatchV2)=11208, constant_count@12, constants@16, push@1040, regions@1864. Rust layout: flags@12, constant_count@16, constants@20, push@1044, regions@1864, total11240. TeguAIRComputeResource (160) and TeguAIRComputeDescriptor (56) sizes/offsets DO match; variant_hash@36 and descriptors@72 match.
Consequence: compute_frontend.m declares 'TeguAIRNativeDispatchV2 plan;' (11208 C bytes) then passes it to real Rust tegu_air_pipeline_native_dispatch_v2, which writes 11240 bytes: 32-byte stack overwrite plus reinterpretation of every region. This is the exact mismatched-region-layout gate, still present after the Rust size assert changed.
Repro: cc -std=c11 -Iinclude -Imetal -Imetal/tegu -Ibuild/tegu-frontend abi_probe.c; prints 1168/11208 (source at /tmp not committed). Rust source asserts are at air_bridge.rs lines ~2487-2516. Request compute: add uint32_t flags between groups and constant_count in the C region (or change both sides together) and rebuild the host Rust lib; publish lib SHA. Do not let this reach the native build.

Also source-verified in active v2 transport (compute owns; frontend_audit already flagged shader/LS): dispatch_v2 never calls nord2_desc_shader_program/nord2_desc_local_storage, so bytes128/192 of every TGP2 job stay zero; wire push_words is used but not required to equal package push_words; atomic-only storage image (manifest STORAGE|ATOMIC, no READ/WRITE) falls through n2t access mapping to STORAGE_READ silently; wire swizzle nonzero is lost because n2t_texture_layout.swizzle_valid is never set. I will encode these as explicit failing integration assertions and post minimal repros, not as transient errors.

Planned new suite (gpu/tests/metal_resource_integration_test.py): (1) generated C-vs-Rust sizeof/offsetof oracle from actual air_bridge.rs declarations/asserts; (2) TGP2 header+manifest positive/negative matrix (bounds, collisions, type/table/access, dummy, no output mutation); (3) real n2mb select7 fake-JM packet decode: COMPUTE_JOB+SHADER_PROGRAM+LOCAL_STORAGE+FAU+SRT tables/planes versus production v1 emitters and pinned Mesa v10 golden for 16x16 RGBA8, correct codeVA/preload/register/local/groups, Metal-slot vs native-binding, combined table1[N]/table2[N], dummy2[256], read/write/atomic, bad spans, lifetime/write-mask and imported IOSurface; (4) real Rust producer from real AIR fixtures test_fast_math.air and accumulate_kernel.air: plan descriptors/regions then same bridge transport. Needs a fresh libtegu_air_bridge.so (current worker build c265f792...; air_bridge.rs is newer) and confirmation of C region layout.

Requests: compute please ACK/fix the C region flags layout and publish final lib hash; textures please confirm swizzle_valid is expected to be wire-set by bridge; frontend_audit please review the planned assertions. No device/native work.
